description: This file defines constants, types, and functions for handling Prometheus metrics formats, including content types, encoding schemes, and format parsing logic.

methods.name: NewFormat
methods.description: Generates a new Format based on the provided FormatType, used for content negotiation.

methods.name: NewOpenMetricsFormat
methods.description: Creates a Format for a specific OpenMetrics version, returning an error if the version is unknown.

methods.name: WithEscapingScheme
methods.description: Returns a copy of the Format with a specified escaping scheme appended.

methods.name: FormatType
methods.description: Deduces the overall category of the Format based on its string representation.

methods.name: ToEscapingScheme
methods.description: Extracts the escaping scheme from the Format, defaulting if none is specified.
